glossary.RIR: Reps in reserve — how many more reps you could have done before failing. RIR 2 = you had 2 left. Newer? Just estimate: could I do 1–2 more?
glossary.rep range: The target reps per set (e.g. 4–8). Stay in the range; when every set hits the top, add weight next time.
glossary.double progression: Add reps until you top the range, then add weight and drop back to the bottom of the range. That's the whole recommendation engine.
glossary.deload: A deliberately lighter session to recover when progress stalls. Not a failure — it's how you keep progressing.
glossary.e1RM: Estimated one-rep max from your set (Epley: load × (1 + reps/30)). A single number to compare hard sets across days.
glossary.hard set: A set taken close enough to failure to drive growth (at or under your hard-set RIR ceiling). These are what the volume audit counts.
glossary.Easy effort: You could have done several more reps — about 3 reps in reserve (RIR 3). Use this when the set felt comfortable.
glossary.Hard effort: You were working but not grinding — about 1 rep in reserve (RIR 1). This is the sweet spot for most working sets.
glossary.Max effort: You were at or very near failure — 0 reps in reserve (RIR 0). Save this for your last set or when you're pushing hard.
glossary.Effort: Easy ≈ 3 reps in reserve, Hard ≈ 1, Max ≈ 0. Pick how the set felt; Taurifer converts it to RIR for its coaching math.

tour.0.body: A local-only tracker for progressive overload — everything stays on this device, nothing is uploaded. This quick tour shows every feature. Tap Next to begin, or Skip tour anytime.
tour.1.body: Pick your training day and date, then enter each set's load, reps and RIR. Taurifer reads your history and tells you when you're ready to add load.
tour.2.body: Switch between List to see the whole session and Focus to work one exercise at a time — easier to tap through mid-set on a phone.
tour.3.body: In Focus, swipe the card or use the header arrows to move between exercises. Enter the numbers and tap Log set to bank a set — tap any logged set to fix it. Turn on the mic in Settings to log a set by voice from the ⋯ menu.
tour.4.body: In Focus, the header rest control starts and stops the rest timer. On Today, the orange-dot line shows how many lifts are ready for more weight.
tour.rest_preview_hint: Rest is off. Enable it in Settings to use the timer.
tour.5.body: When you're done, tap Finish workout to save. Your Stats and History update instantly — and a rest/backup reminder appears when it's time.
tour.6.body: Track progress across Overview, Strength, Volume, PRs and a plain-language Review. Open Dig deeper for charts and per-exercise trends.
tour.7.body: Every saved session and every individual set lives here. Tap a session to review — or edit a past workout if you logged something wrong.
tour.8.body: Build your split in the visual editor — days, exercises, muscles and rep ranges. See planned weekly volume, and use End block to review a mesocycle and plan the next one.
tour.9.body: Set your units and RIR style, tune progression, and manage backups — export or import JSON/CSV. Since data lives only on this device, keep a backup.
tour.install.body_prefix: Add Taurifer to your home screen for a fast, full-screen, offline app that works with no signal.
